correctness.rationale: The multiplication in the inversion semidirect product gives the four conjugation operations in RESULT.md. Substituting (x,y,z,t)=(S_a,S_a,R_0,S_{a+b}) in the medial law forces S_a=S_{a+4b}. Conversely the proposed fibers are preserved by the operations and their right inverses. On A/4A, right translations are translations by even elements or maps x→2b−x; the two kinds commute because all fourth multiples vanish. Their restrictions to rotations also commute. The self-distributivity identity for right translations then proves mediality, establishing minimality without a finiteness assumption. Cyclic fourth-multiple quotients have size gcd(n,4), giving the cardinalities, including the trivial-action cases. The finite checker was inspected but not run; its 24 completed examples are recorded evidence only. The independent group-orbit specialization below also proves the identifications.

The older Bardakov–Sangare mediality criterion alone is not the quotient computation.
